description: Floating toolbar that appears on text selection (pointer or keyboard). Moves its authored action children into a generated <pop-over data-mode="manual" role="toolbar"> in the top layer; Alt+F10 focuses it, arrow keys rove, Escape returns focus and the selection.

attributes.name: for
attributes.description: ID of a single target element to watch for text selection. When the menu also has an id, the target is marked data-selection-menu="<id>".

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: When set, every element with data-selection-menu="<id>" is a target (many-to-one); targets added or changed later are picked up.

attributes.name: data-label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the toolbar (aria-label on the composed pop-over)

childAttributes.name: data-selection-menu
childAttributes.description: On a target element: the id of the selection-menu that serves it

events.name: selection-menu:select
events.detail: { range: Range, text: string, target: Element }
events.description: A selection inside a target opened (or moved) the toolbar

events.name: selection-menu:dismiss
events.description: The toolbar was hidden (outside pointerdown, Escape, dismiss(), selection collapsed from the keyboard, or scrolled out of view)

events.name: selection-menu:actions-changed
events.detail: { actions: Array<{ tag, attrs?, html? }>, source: 'property' }
events.description: The actions property replaced the toolbar children

methods.name: getSelection
methods.returns: { range: Range, text: string, target: Element } | null
methods.description: The selection the toolbar is showing for (a cloned range), or null when hidden

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Hide the toolbar; focus inside it returns to the selection's target

properties.name: actions
properties.type: Array<{ tag: string, attrs?: object, html?: string } | Element>
properties.description: Toolbar children as plain data; setting it replaces them and fires selection-menu:actions-changed

structure.description: Generated toolbar surface; setup() moves the authored children into it. Style this node, not the host (the host is display: contents).
Share or copy the selected text as a quote (detected via closest('selection-menu'))
